_comment: Accepted Cisco skill-scanner findings, each read by a reviewer. Remove an entry to re-evaluate it.

accepted.title: Skill package contains many files
accepted.reason: Reviewed 2026-09-11: deck-images ships its assets inside the skill: 92 Carbon icons as SVG plus the same 92 as PNG glyphs (Apache-2.0, one LICENSE and NOTICE), 12 pattern tiles, and a 26-picture library generated by the pack authors (JPEG, NOTICE and manifest.json). Every file is static media with no script content.
